value="Reading guide:

Solid arrows = data path · Dashed = control / external
Stacked rectangles = horizontally scaled clusters (N pods)
Step IDs: , e.g. A3 = Flow A, step 3

Step Sequence:
A (Place Order): A1 client→APIGW · A2 APIGW→OMS
 A3 RMS pre-check (block margin) · A4 OMS INSERT orders + outbox (txn)
 A5 produce orders.events · A6 ExchangeGW reads outbox + sends FIX
 A7 exchange ACK · A8 OMS UPDATE OPEN, push WS to user

B (Fill): B1 exchange fill on drop-copy · B2 ExchangeGW publishes trades.events
 B3 OMS updates order status (FILLED/PARTIAL) · B4 Funds debits ledger
 B5 Portfolio updates pos · pushes P&amp;L to user via WS

C (Tick): C1 multicast tick · C2 MD-Feed normalizes
 C3 produce md.ticks Kafka + cache LTP in Redis
 C4 WS gateway fans out to subscribed users

D (Cancel/Modify): D1 client→OMS · D2 OMS sends FIX cancel/replace
 D3 ack from exchange → OMS UPDATE → WS push

E (GTT/SL): E1 GTT engine tails md.ticks · E2 trigger condition true
 E3 enqueue orders.events → reuse Flow A from A4

F (EOD recon): F1 ingest exchange trade-file · F2 reconcile DB
 F3 generate contract notes · email · S3 WORM

G (Square-off): G1 SQR consumes md.ticks + computes MTM
 G2 detect margin breach · G3 enqueue MARKET sell via OMS (Flow A)

H (Funds): H1 client → Funds Svc · H2 bank API call (UPI collect)
 H3 webhook from bank → ledger CREDIT" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="195" width="490" x="20" y="345" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="97" connectable="0" parent="1" style="group;fontSize=14;movable=1;resizable=1;rotatable=1;deletable=1;editable=1;locked=0;connectable=1;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="142" width="334" x="1110" y="2800" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="98" parent="97" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;arcSize=10;fontSize=14;movable=1;resizable=1;rotatable=1;deletable=1;editable=1;locked=0;connectable=1;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="320" x="14" y="12" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="99" parent="97" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;arcSize=10;fontSize=14;movable=1;resizable=1;rotatable=1;deletable=1;editable=1;locked=0;connectable=1;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="320" x="8" y="6" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="100" parent="97" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;arcSize=10;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;movable=1;resizable=1;rotatable=1;deletable=1;editable=1;locked=0;connectable=1;" value="Exchange Gateway (active/standby per exchange)

② RMS check + margin-block is ATOMIC with order INSERT (single Postgres txn)

③ OMS is the ONLY writer to orders table; Exchange Gateway only sends FIX

④ Exchange drop-copy is the source of truth for fills (NOT the order ack)

⑤ Funds ledger is SERIALIZABLE — no read-modify-write outside a txn

⑥ Every order ↔ trade ↔ fund-event is reconciled EOD against exchange file

⑦ Market data is best-effort eventual; orders/trades are strongly consistent

⑧ At-least-once Kafka + idempotent consumers (dedupe by event_id)

⑨ All API calls produce an audit.event — immutable, 8-yr retention" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="280" width="500" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="121" parent="119" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=#fafafa;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=14;fontStyle=0;fontColor=#222222;whiteSpace=wrap;movable=1;resizable=1;rotatable=1;deletable=1;editable=1;locked=0;connectable=1;" value="Latency budget — order placement

div.div:
Reading guide:
Solid arrows = data path · Dashed = control / external
Stacked rectangles = horizontally scaled clusters (N pods)
Step IDs: , e.g. A3 = Flow A, step 3
Step Sequence:
A (Place Order): A1 client→APIGW · A2 APIGW→OMS
A3 RMS pre-check (block margin) · A4 OMS INSERT orders + outbox (txn)
A5 produce orders.events · A6 ExchangeGW reads outbox + sends FIX
A7 exchange ACK · A8 OMS UPDATE OPEN, push WS to user
B (Fill): B1 exchange fill on drop-copy · B2 ExchangeGW publishes trades.events
B3 OMS updates order status (FILLED/PARTIAL) · B4 Funds debits ledger
B5 Portfolio updates pos · pushes P&L to user via WS
C (Tick): C1 multicast tick · C2 MD-Feed normalizes
C3 produce md.ticks Kafka + cache LTP in Redis
C4 WS gateway fans out to subscribed users
D (Cancel/Modify): D1 client→OMS · D2 OMS sends FIX cancel/replace
D3 ack from exchange → OMS UPDATE → WS push
E (GTT/SL): E1 GTT engine tails md.ticks · E2 trigger condition true
E3 enqueue orders.events → reuse Flow A from A4
F (EOD recon): F1 ingest exchange trade-file · F2 reconcile DB
F3 generate contract notes · email · S3 WORM
G (Square-off): G1 SQR consumes md.ticks + computes MTM
G2 detect margin breach · G3 enqueue MARKET sell via OMS (Flow A)
H (Funds): H1 client → Funds Svc · H2 bank API call (UPI collect)
H3 webhook from bank → ledger CREDIT

div.div: 9 Key Invariants

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 498px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1837px; margin-left: 5532px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #222222;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#222222, #d0d0d0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
① Idempotency-Key on every order (client_order_id) — double-tap → 1 order
② RMS check + margin-block is ATOMIC with order INSERT (single Postgres txn)
③ OMS is the ONLY writer to orders table; Exchange Gateway only sends FIX
④ Exchange drop-copy is the source of truth for fills (NOT the order ack)
⑤ Funds ledger is SERIALIZABLE — no read-modify-write outside a txn
⑥ Every order ↔ trade ↔ fund-event is reconciled EOD against exchange file
⑦ Market data is best-effort eventual; orders/trades are strongly consistent
⑧ At-least-once Kafka + idempotent consumers (dedupe by event_id)
⑨ All API calls produce an audit.event — immutable, 8-yr retention

switch.text: ① Idempotency-Key on every order (client_order_id) — double-tap → 1 order...

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 498px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2117px; margin-left: 5532px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#222222, #d0d0d0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Latency budget — order placement
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
client → API GW : 10 ms
AuthZ + RL : 2 ms (Redis)
OMS validate : 5 ms
RMS pre-trade : 5 ms (Redis state)
PG INSERT (orders + outbox txn) : 8 ms
FIX produce + ack : 10 ms (in-VPC)
back to client : 10 ms
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
total p50 : ~50 ms
